Commissioned industrial-scale biochar facility in Jalgaon with ~20,000 tonnes/annum capacity (50+ TPD).
Biochar plant started operations with first orders from Coffee Board
Target to recover ₹380 Cr from legacy receivables in remaining 9 months of FY27
Signed an agreement with Supercritical for up to 19,000 tonnes of biochar carbon removal credits for 2026 and 2027 from its Jalgaon facility.

timeline.summary: ICRA downgraded Jain Irrigation's ₹787.24 Cr NCDs to [ICRA]BB+ (Negative) and withdrew the rating at the company's request.
Jain Irrigation reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,824 Cr, up 4.3% YoY, with EBITDA of ₹240 Cr.
JISL shared the Q4/FY26 earnings conference call audio recording link on May 15, 2026, via **A. V. Ghodgaonkar**, Company Secretary.
Jain Irrigation reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,824 Cr, up 4.3% YoY.
Jain Irrigation commissioned an industrial-scale biochar facility in Jalgaon with a capacity of ~20,000 tonnes per annum on June 2, 2026.
Jain Irrigation held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 10, 2026, reporting flat revenue but margin decline due to monsoon delays and polymer price volatility
Jain Irrigation signed a deal with Supercritical for up to 19,000 tonnes of biochar carbon removal credits for 2026 and 2027.
